name: Righteous Path
uniques: Resting point for Influence with City-States is increased by [15]

civilopediaText.text: Strict clan law (族规) keeps members in line. Obedience is cheaper than unrest.

policies.name: Righteous Alliance
uniques: City-State Influence recovers at twice the normal rate
Gifts of Gold to City-States generate [+25]% more Influence

civilopediaText.text: Righteous clans band together against a shared threat, and keep count of who owes whom. Small clans remember who paid them.
A righteous village is held, not abandoned. Its walls and its defenders are built for that.

policies.name: Righteous Path Complete
uniques: Earn [100]% of killed [Demonic Infamy] unit's [Cost] as [Gold]

civilopediaText.text: A stable clan feeds its Gu efficiently. Order is a resource too.
The righteous path (正道): clan law, alliances and a respectable face. Righteous clans kill as readily as demonic ones; they keep better records of why.

name: Demonic Path
uniques: Triggers a [Betrayal] event <upon turn start> <with [3]% chance>
All newly-trained [Military] units [in all cities] receive the [Demonic Infamy] promotion

policies.name: Plunder
uniques: Receive [+100]% Gold from Barbarian encampments and pillaging Cities

civilopediaText.text: Demonic Gu Masters strip whatever they overrun. Nothing left behind is wasted.

policies.name: Lone Cultivators
uniques: [+30]% unhappiness from the number of cities

civilopediaText.text: A lone cultivator (散修) has no clan behind them, and on the Southern Border every demonic Gu Master is one: few, strong, travelling light, owing nothing to anyone. Every new village they hold is one more place to be betrayed.

policies.name: Ruthless Cultivation
uniques: Upon capturing a city, receive [3] times its [Gold] production as [Gold] immediately

civilopediaText.text: War feeds the Gu; peace starves them; mortals pay either way. A captured village pays for the war that took it.
Strike first and strike hardest. The second blow is for those who missed the first.
The demonic path (魔道): take what you need by force and trust no one. It pays well and makes enemies faster than it makes stones.

name: Moon Path
uniques: [+5]% Strength <for [Moon Master] units> <for every [Adopted [[Moon Path] branch] Policies]>

civilopediaText.text: Path insight multiplies Gu of the same path. Moon Gu in moon hands cut deeper.
More orchid beds in the spring cave and on the slopes. More petals, more blades.
Moon cultivators strike and slip away before the answer comes. A moon cultivator who stands still is a target.

policies.name: Moon Path Complete
uniques: New [Gu Master] units start with [10] XP [in all cities]

civilopediaText.text: The clan's moon tradition is fully mastered; its students arrive already blooded. The academy stops training students and starts training killers.
The moon path (月道): Gu that shape moonlight into blades. On Qing Mao that art means the Gu Yue clan and its Moonlight Gu. Lighter on the treasury than strength, and dependent on orchids.

name: Strength Path
uniques: [+5]% Strength <for [Strength Master] units> <for every [Adopted [[Strength Path] branch] Policies]>

civilopediaText.text: Path insight multiplies the boar strength grafted onto the body. A boar Gu is only as strong as the body that carries it.
Strength cultivators prove themselves against beast packs, and bring the meat home. The meat feeds the clan's boar Gu.

policies.name: Unyielding Body
uniques: Heals [10] damage if it kills a unit

civilopediaText.text: A tempered body recovers in the middle of a fight. The enemy tires first.
The body itself becomes the weapon, and the weapon moves faster. Few clans ever get this far down one path.
The strength path (力道): Gu that add raw might to the body itself. It hits hardest and eats the most.

civilopediaText.text: The transformation path (变化道) as a clan's tradition (Body & Beast): its Masters grow with every policy of the branch, and it opens the Transformation Hall.

A policy of the Transformation Path: +1 production in every city.

uniques: Heals [15] damage if it kills a unit <for [Transformation Master] units>
